{{Quote|This is Organa Palace? Where I'm from, you could fit a whole town in there.|[[Corso Riggs]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Castle Organa''', alternatively known as '''Organa Palace''', was the ancestral home and estate of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] which was located on the [[Apalis Coast]] of the pristine [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It served as a base of operations for the Organas during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

During this time, [[Aleyna Hark]] served in the palace. No one knew of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan's]] allegiance to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or their intention to take control of the [[Death Mark laser|Death Mark]] project. A [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] was therefore tasked with ending the threat posed by the Death Mark.
